A RECIPE FOR ADVENTURE

Welcome to the sauce side.

Explore a ketchup floor, barbecue-sauce walls, and a drippy mustard ceiling. The roof is shown as a cutaway so you can see your way around.

WASD / arrows
Walk or fly your lap
Space / ↑
Jump
Q / Squirt
Spray your mixed sauce at Squeeze
E / action
Race, get a hint, or use the shower
Drag / swipe
Look around
Scroll / pinch
Zoom

Watch Squeeze: Get close and he aims a sauce squirt. Paint him with your mix and he squirts that color back at you! Move away from the landing ring, or jump just before it splats! He keeps his squirts to himself during races.

Maze race: Start at the checkered arch. Squeeze is extra speedy now! You get a one-second head start. Keep your turns sharp! Cross the checkered stripe under the golden exit before him! Choose any route, through or around the maze. The whole stripe counts from any direction, even if you jump. Tap Show mustard trail if you need a hand. Explore or practice as often as you like.

If Squeeze wins: He flicks you out of the world! Your flying french fry catches you. Hold a movement direction or tap Fly to circle the whole world twice. You land back home automatically after two full laps. Pausing or reversing is fine; retracing your path does not earn extra laps.

Sauce Lab: Find the colorful bottles to the right of the race plaza. Choose up to four squirts from six sauces, then mix at least two squirts. The same color twice works too! Ketchup + mustard makes Lava sauce. Watch the swirl turn into a colorful fountain and paint your apron! Tap Jump in & mix me to hop into the bowl, whirl around, and bounce safely out. Close the panel or move to leave early. Tap Take sauce to carry a bottle. Get near Squeeze with a clear view, then tap Squirt Squeeze or press Q. Your sauce automatically aims and paints him that color! Your bottle refills itself. Empty the bowl to invent another recipe. Walk, jump, or close the panel to leave.

Extra flavors: Meet six spice friends inside the maze. Bounce on the giant pickle. Try the seasoning shower to clean off ketchup and get a little protection.

No lives to lose. All prizes stay for this visit. Menus pause play. Sound is optional.
